newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jurong Shipyard up on takeover rumours.
newsitem.headline: Jurong Shipyard up on takeover rumours.

text.p: Shares in Jurong Shipyard rose sharply on Wednesday as rumours of a takeover by Sembawang Shipyard resurfaced, dealers said.
It topped the gainers, soaring Singapore $0.40 to S$6.45 on volume of 603,000 shares by 0346 GMT.
Shares in Sembawang rose in tandem, gaining S$0.35 to S$6.80 on turnover of 579,000 shares traded.
"The stock's sharp rise is fuelled by the takeover rumours, which seem to surface every three months," said a dealer with a foreign bank.
Dealers said the steep climb could be boosted by a statement from Keppel Corp that it saw a positive outlook for the ship repair industry.
Keppel Corp made the statement on Tuesday at the opening of its new S$100 million dry dock.
